target.description: Fit source latent-state/network descriptions and assess their reproducibility under unchanged model hyperparameters; free-energy optimization is the potential ordered source route.

dataset.description: CTF resting MEG and Elekta visual-task MEG used in the original paper. Payloads were not read.

cohort.description: CTF 65 healthy participants; Elekta 19 participants with six runs each.

split.description: Original group models use concatenated participant data. A new held-person partition is an extension, not the published fitting comparison.

inputs.description: Source-reconstructed regional MEG time series; original static, burst and network branches retain distinct inputs.

preprocessing.description: Reviewed CTF code uses 250 Hz data, 15 time embeddings, 80 PCA components, standardization, 8 HMM states or 7 DyNeMo modes. Historical cded3b2 versus registered 064104d recipe correspondence remains unqualified.

metric.description: Paper describes variational free energy for fixed-hyperparameter fit ordering. Historical HMM free energy differs from DyNeMo final sampled training-epoch loss; exact criterion, branch normalization and reported values are not recovered.

aggregation.description: Paper describes best of 10 selection and three independent sets. Historical HMM free energy and DyNeMo final history[loss][-1] are distinct criteria; post-fit free_energy() cannot recover the sampled final training trajectory. Exact original selection/aggregation remains unresolved.

full_panel.description: All six original empirical branches: Figure1 CTF bursts, Figure2 Elekta AE-HMM, Figure3 Elekta TDE-HMM, Figure4 CTF TDE-HMM, Figure5 CTF DyNeMo and Figure6 CTF static. CTF retains subject00–subject64; Elekta retains sub01–sub19 and all six runs. Retain all three burst states, eight HMM states, seven continuous modes,38Giles parcels, full frequency support, both NNMF components, all event trials/times, four static bands, per-person burst/occupancy/lifetime/interval/switching summaries, full spatial/spectral states, continuous-mode coactivation, age contrasts and complete thresholded/unthresholded connectivity. Preserve literal source age/event inference alongside separately named harmonized65-person age and corrected19-person event sensitivities; preserve stationary/static companion obligations while keeping the changed-split held-person implementation separate. The15declared scalar selected-fit statistics do not cover these required tensor-valued findings: they remain unresolved full-panel obligations without invented scalar reductions. Figures7–12 methodological/simulation illustrations remain separate unresolved whole-paper obligations. No single scalar,fixed-fit audit or held-person likelihood replaces this panel.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same paper and complete original source-reconstructed regional MEG, original event streams/annotations, demographics and common contract; the original group fit can use its complete source cohort. The paper_data_author_code condition adds only the authenticated historical author source. Published fitted matrices, pretrained checkpoints, inf_params, deposited spectra, operator references and private evaluation state are not candidate inputs. The five-fold held-person programme is a separate extension and cannot change this original reproduction split.

Native age-label discrepancy and distinct static/dynamic boundaries must remain explicit alongside separately named harmonized sensitivities; the accepted65-person identity join is source-only software evidence.
